Question: A circular piece of metal of maximum size is cut out of a square piece and then a square piece of maximum size is cut out of the circular piece. The total amount of metal wasted is:

Choices.A: \(\dfrac14\) the area of the original square
Choices.B:
\(\dfrac12\) the area of the original
square
Choices.C: \(\dfrac12\) the area of the circular piece
Choices.D: \(\dfrac14\) the area of the circular piece
